label: methylphenidate HCl 20 mg oral (Ritalin tablet), fasted, n=30 men
note: FDA ANDA 40-300 (Mallinckrodt) bioequivalence review PDF page 14, Table 2, column MEAN2 (Ritalin reference). Fasted healthy men, weight not reported. Achiral LC-MS/MS: total racemic methylphenidate, as the preset. LLOQ 0.25 ng/mL. The 20 min mean (0.32 ng/mL) is barely above it: most subjects had no measurable drug yet.
